domain_restrictions: n is an integer with n > 1
k is an integer with 1 <= k <= n
t is a real number (no extra restriction stated in the quantifiers)
floor is the greatest integer less than or equal to its real argument (implicitly requires k times t to be real, which it is)
semantic_sketch_json.normalized_claim: For all integers n with n > 1 and for all real numbers t, if for all integers k with 1 <= k <= n the equality floor(k times t) = k minus 1 holds, then E_n(t) = H_n minus 1.
quantifier_order: for every integer n such that n > 1
if for every integer k such that 1 <= k <= n, floor(k times t) = k minus 1

variables.name: n
variables.role: global parameter in quantifiers; index for E_n(t) and H_n

variables.name: t
variables.role: real input for floor and for E_n(t)

variables.name: k
variables.role: index ranging over 1 to n in the premise condition

witness_dependencies: no existential witnesses are introduced; the premise universally quantifies k for fixed n and t

statement_nl: For every integer n>1 and every real number t, if floor(k*t) = k-1 for every integer k with 1 <= k <= n, then E_n(t) = H_n - 1.
